newsitem.title: JAPAN: ANA names new president-designate,chairman resigns.
newsitem.headline: ANA names new president-designate,chairman resigns.

text.p: All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA) said on Thursday that Kichisaburo Nomura will be its new president, instead of the previously announced president-designate Kenzo Yoshikawa.
Nomura will assume the president's post in late June, ANA officials told a news conference.
ANA chairman Takaya Sugiura said at the same news conference that he was resigning as chairman on Thursday and would step down from his post as a director in June.
Japanese media reports said the changes in top personnel reflected management wrangling that started earlier this month.
On May 13, ANA announced that Yoshikawa, currently the president of ANA Real Estate Co Ltd, an ANA-related company, would replace ANA's current president, Seiji Fukatsu.
Japanese media said Fukatsu would step down after disagreements over management and personnel issues with chairman Sugiura and honorary chairman Tokuji Wakasa.
Ten days later, ANA said Wakasa would resign as a director, a move that media reports said was to take responsibility for the dispute which prompted Fukatsu's resignation.
Wakasa, an 82-year-old former vice transport minister, has been under fire since ANA announced that Fukatsu would resign, media reports said.
ANA said on Thursday that Yoshikawa would remain ANA Real Estate's president after June.
